harness: probe service (tools/stallfloor/probe.py): frozen kernel families, every thread of every launch judged against a host-computed checksum
what: 27 requests of probe.py 34 (thirteenth build), all kind ord, six grids (1, 8, 9, 12 and 16 warps per SM, and 2 CTAs of 9 warps per SM), 40 repetitions, no word in front: SETS OF PRODUCERS ON ONE WRITE BARRIER READ BEHIND ONE WAIT - an older `LDG.E.CONSTANT` beside a younger `LDG.E.128.STRONG.GPU`, and ten more sets of that family. Every member carries the yield flag; the members stand 1, 4 and 11 cycles apart, the youngest at stall 2. Fifteen measuring requests and twelve twins that must fail. (r) The pair N,T = `LDG.E.CONSTANT`, `LDG.E.128.STRONG.GPU`: r_nt_o_p - the OLDER's register read into a predicate by `ISETP.GE.AND P3` that carries the one wait; r_nt_o_p_f - the one wait on a word that reads no member, the `ISETP` behind it without one; r_nt_o - the pair read into data, the older first; r_nt_y - the YOUNGER read first; r_gnkt_ll_o_p - the pair under two predicates written negated, every combination of executed and nullified inside one warp; r_gnkt_ll_o_p_f - under two predicates, not negated, the wait on a word in front, each member also setting the read barrier of the set's number; r_n8t8_o_p - eight `LDG.E.CONSTANT`, then eight `LDG.E.128.STRONG.GPU` (sixteen producers on the barrier), the oldest read into the predicate; r_n3t3_lll_o_p_f - three and three under three negated predicates, the wait on a word in front. (c) c_c_t8_o - `LDC.64` and eight `LDG.E.128.STRONG.GPU`, the `LDC.64` read first; c_cl_o - `LDC.64` and `LDCU.64`. (b) Sets of one form: b_n4_p - four `LDG.E.CONSTANT`, the oldest read into a predicate; b_n5 - five; b_n4i - four with a `SHFL.IDX` between them; b_gkn_ll - two `LDG.E.CONSTANT` under two negated predicates in front of an unguarded one, the wait on a word that reads no member. (d) d_t5 - five `LDG.E.128.STRONG.GPU` under three predicates. THE TWINS: <id>_n = the same words with NO barrier and NO wait (the sets without a predicate); <id>_ew | <id>_fe = the reader's wait bit moved to the first word BEHIND the reader words (the sets under predicates) - the reader must not be right wherever a producer executes. A request without a predicate also runs its text with every member on its own barrier and wait

conditions.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition
conditions.card_state: a Server Edition card (this model takes no clock offset); the probe alone, no power limit

classes.good: the intended values in all 256 iterations
classes.stale: raw / ord: the consumer took the register's previous content in all 256
classes.late: war: the store took the rewritten register in all 256
classes.overtake: war: the read-back saw the slot before the store in all 256
